pattern.name: Riverbank sweeps
pattern.description: Riverbank sweeps: two broad offset eddy-shaped sweeps and a low bank contour on a muted blue-gray river field, with open flowing geometry rather than concentric circles.

background.status: Selected independent presentation for the explicitly authorized ten-project batch.

framing.note: One uniform centered placement of the complete animal and accessory. Scale selected from border-connected native foreground estimates with a 145 px preliminary buffer, then enforced against the actual extracted rounded outline at 128 px. No repositioned parts, stretched anatomy, added contours or internal crops.

matte.calibrationNote: The matte RGB is the modal value from the untouched native outer eight-pixel border. Remove only exterior-connected near-white; inspect pale anatomy, enclosed highlights and inner negative spaces separately. No component cleanup is assumed.
